messages:
maya: Quick sync — console PR #8422 updates the client surface and needs the SDK + API changes merged in the right order. I can’t land until SDK exposes new `ListRoutesV2` and runtime helm charts are bumped.

maya: Summary: console/#8422 depends on api/#538 (interface change) and sdk/#1297 (client shim). runtime/helm needs a patch to point to new image tag.

raj: I can take api/#538 review now. will post comments in ~45min.

liam: sdk/#1297 is waiting on a minor rename (we renamed `route` -> `route_v2`). I pushed a small commit to fix tests but need someone to approve the shim change to keep backwards compat.

maya: @liam can you paste the failing test output?

liam: here — failing assertion in client_test.go:```\n--- FAIL: TestRouteParsing (0.00s)\n    client_test.go:82: expected 3 routes, got 0\n```

liam: local repro: `make test-unit ./pkg/sdk` — I’ll add a quick patch.

jen: I can do the SDK approval after the test fix. ETA 1hr.

maya: thanks. once sdk/#1297 is green and merged, we should merge api/#538, then console/#8422, then bump helm runtime image and run canary. sequence matters because console build picks up generated client code.

sophia: I’ll take the helm chart bump. ping me when console is merged and image tag is available. I’ll prepare a canary release with 10% traffic.

maya: ideal sequence: 1) sdk merge, 2) api merge & compatible tag, 3) console merge, 4) build image `redwood/runtime:staging-20260317-v2`, 5) helm bump PR against charts/runtime 6) canary deploy.

raj: noted. api/#538 has one question about error returns — I’ll add a small follow-up. shouldn’t block merge once addressed.

ci-bot: CI status — sdk/#1297: failing (unit), api/#538: pending (integration), console/#8422: blocked (sdk not merged)

liam: pushed fix and rebased onto main. tests pass locally. triggered CI. `git push origin fix-route-rename`

ci-bot: SDK CI — sdk/#1297 -> passed (unit), integration queued.

jen: reviewing sdk now. small nit but fine. approving. :thumbsup:

jen: APPROVED sdk/#1297 — feel free to merge once integration is green.

ci-bot: api/#538 integration -> failed (flake)

raj: I’ll rerun the flaky test. looks like a timing-related TTL check. rerunning.

raj: rerun passed. updated PR description to call out change log. APPROVED api/#538.

maya: sdk and api merged. console CI will pick up new client. console/#8422 CI started.

deploy-bot: staging deploy started for `redwood/runtime:staging-20260317-v2` (helm release `runtime-staging`, namespace `staging`).

jen: console/#8422 build is green. pushing final commit to update changelog. ready to merge after one more approval (sophia to confirm helm compatibility).

sophia: checked chart diff; only image tag change + probe tweaks. LGTM.

maya: merging console now and opening helm PR with the image tag. helm PR: charts/runtime#412.

maya: helm/#412 references `image.tag: staging-20260317-v2`. Please review canary config.

sophia: reviewing helm/#412 — will enable `canary.enabled: true` and `canary.weight: 10` for rollout.

ci-bot: helm/#412 lint -> passed. integration tests for chart -> passed.

deploy-bot: canary deploy complete: 10% traffic to `runtime-staging` at staging-20260317-v2. No errors observed in logs for 15m.

maya: quick smoke commands I ran:```\n# compare api contracts\n./scripts/compare-apis.sh api/main sdk/main\n\n# run e2e against staging\nmake e2e ENV=staging\n```

liam: all good from SDK side after the fix. thanks team.

raj: leaving one post-merge task: add a short migration note to CHANGELOGs (api and sdk). I’ll open a tiny PR for that.

maya: awesome. final checklist: [x] sdk merged, [x] api merged, [x] console merged, [x] image built, [x] helm PR merged, [x] canary ok. I’ll schedule the full rollout at 30m if no regressions.

jen: happy to monitor metrics during rollout.

deploy-bot: full rollout scheduled in 30m unless cancelled.

maya: thanks everyone — feel free to DM if anything pops up.

liam: thumbs up.

raj: thanks — will follow up on changelogs.

sophia: copying release notes into docs/ops later today.

ci-bot: thread archived (no further CI events).
